caseNameFull: Hoffa v. United States Parks v. United States Campbell v. United States and King v. United States

opinions.text:
385 U. S. 293; ante, p. 940. Motion of Criminal Courts Bar Association of Los Angeles County for leave to file a brief in No. 32, as amicus curiae, in support of petition for rehearing granted. Petition for rehearing in all four cases denied.

Mr. Justice White and Mr. Justice Fortas took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion or this petition.
